text: Good afternoon everyone and welcome to today's special council meeting on December the 19th.
As we begin today's meeting, I'd like to acknowledge that we gather on the traditional territory
of the neutral Anishinaabe and Haudenosaunee peoples.
We recognize our responsibility to serve as stewards for the land
and honor the original caretakers who came before us.
Our community is enriched by the enduring knowledge and deep-rooted traditions
of the diverse First Nations, Métis and Inuit in Kitchener today.
We have a number of items to go into camera for.
Two matters relating to land acquisition and disposition
and one pertaining to security of property.
So I'll deal with that one first because there is an additional item as well.
So if somebody wants to move, go in camera for those items.
Councillor Chapman, seconded by Councillor Johnston.
All those in favour?
Opposed? That's carried. I also understand there's an additional item under solicitor client privilege.
I will need to waive notice first of that. Does somebody want to move away notice?
Councillor Michaud seconded by Councillor Owodunni. All those in favour?
Opposed? That's carried. Motion to go in camera for that additional item.
Moved by Councillor Clancy, seconded by Councillor Deneault.
All those in favour? Opposed? That's carried.
Motion to adjourn.
Councillor Ioannidis, Councillor Michaud.
All those in favour? Opposed? That's carried.
Thank you.
Thank you.
